race.comment: TISHMAN (4) resumed over 2200m at Sale and won very well, coming from back in the field to win by half a length. Goes up a notch here but should only strip fitter for that and has always shown plenty of promise. Splits he ran late on there see him get the nod over ARDASHIR (11) who looks ready to do something. He was much better second up going to 2000m at Mornington when beaten under a length. Gets to his right trip now and Zahra goes on. Won at this point last prep. SLANE (8) mixes form but did run second to TISHMAN two back while HAWK POWER (5) won narrowly last time and is in the mix.
